intro.title: Rooted here. Made to be shared.
body: Texoma Collective brings together the people, places, businesses and stories that make Lake Texoma worth experiencing.

We market businesses, grow businesses and tell the stories that make people fall in love with Texoma - creating a stronger community, a vibrant local economy and a brighter future for the lake we call home.

about.eyebrow: A place. A connection. A story.
about.title: The people behind a stronger Texoma.
about.intro: We are lake lovers, parents, storytellers and industry leaders who have called Lake Texoma home for decades.
body: Our experience in tourism, hospitality, marketing and events gives us a deep understanding of this place and the businesses that keep it thriving.
Texoma Collective brings that knowledge together with a shared passion: telling the stories of our lake, championing its people and helping others discover what makes this community worth knowing.

contact.contactNote: Call the Collective office at 903.200.1408. The Text us widget is a separate messaging line, and replies come from 903.414.6040.

items.a: Texoma Collective is the tourism, marketing, events and sales organization connecting Lake Texoma's visitors, businesses, places and stories.

items.q: Is Texoma Collective a booking site?
items.a: No. Stays and experiences are booked through the participating business or Texoma Destinations. Texoma Collective helps people discover and connect.
The partner network is designed for tourism-facing businesses and organizations across the Lake Texoma region in Texas and Oklahoma.

items.q: Can the team help with a group or event?
items.a: Yes. Use the group and event inquiry option to start a conversation about your plans.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: Texoma Collective collects information you choose to provide through our inquiry forms, including your name, organization, email address, phone number, location and message. We also receive basic technical and usage information through security, hosting and analytics services so we can operate and improve the website.

We use this information to respond to requests, route inquiries to the appropriate Texoma Collective or participating business contact, provide requested information, understand website performance, prevent misuse and maintain our records.

We may share an inquiry with Texoma Destinations, participating businesses or service providers when reasonably necessary to answer the request or deliver the service you asked about. We do not sell personal information. Third-party services, linked websites and the Text us service maintain their own privacy practices.

We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, legal obligations, security and dispute resolution. You may ask us to review or delete information you submitted by calling 903.200.1408 or writing to Texoma Collective, 81750 N State Hwy 289, Suite 106, Pottsboro, TX 75076.
This website is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13. We may update this notice as our services change; the effective date above identifies the current version.

Links to Texoma Destinations, participating businesses and other third parties are provided for convenience. Those services have their own terms and policies, and Texoma Collective is not responsible for third-party content, transactions or performance.

Website content, branding and original materials are owned by or licensed to Texoma Collective and may not be copied, republished or used commercially without permission. You may use the website for lawful personal or business-inquiry purposes and may not interfere with its operation, submit deceptive information or attempt unauthorized access.

Information is provided as available without a promise that every page will be error-free or continuously available. To the extent permitted by law, Texoma Collective is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the website or reliance on third-party information.

These terms are governed by Texas law. Questions may be directed to Texoma Collective at 903.200.1408 or 81750 N State Hwy 289, Suite 106, Pottsboro, TX 75076. We may update these terms as the website and services change; the effective date above identifies the current version.
